instruction: You are given an assembly template missing contact definitions: `/home/user/Desktop/friction_base.inp`. Complete the following from the command line: 1. Modify and generate `/home/user/Desktop/friction.inp`: Please save the final input file as /home/user/Desktop/friction.inp. - Repair element geometry/connectivity (including node ordering) to eliminate nonpositive Jacobian issues - Define block bottom face as Slave and plate top face as Master - Use `*Contact Pair, interaction=Int-1, type=SURFACE TO SURFACE` - Use `*Surface Interaction, name=Int-1` + `*Surface Behavior, pressure-overclosure=LINEAR` + `*Friction` with coefficient `0.3` - Apply `P=10 MPa` on block top face - Apply `UX=0.1 mm` on plate side face (push the block) - Request displacement/stress/contact-displacement outputs for post-processing 2. Submit the job and write a post-processing script to parse `friction.dat`: - Extract interface tangential displacement (slip) from contact displacement output - Extract maximum Mises stress at interface - Write to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `slip_mm, max_mises` 3. Do not use the CGX GUI.
